component.name: Floe
component.summary: A spatial file manager for Wayland

description.p: Floe is a keyboard-friendly GTK file manager for modern Wayland desktops. It provides list, grid, and Miller-column navigation, asynchronous file operations, search, previews, integrity tools, and standards-based Linux desktop integration.
Floe currently operates with the signed-in user's normal filesystem and desktop-session authority. It is not a sandbox, encrypted vault, malware scanner, or secure-erasure tool.
Initial development release with local file-management workflows.
